about: The four Larpo founder accounts the planner assigns posts to. Voices are summarised from knowledge/x/caption-voice.md; captions are written per account and never copied between accounts (team brain, content pillar). profileId is the X engine profile id (not the handle); the values here are placeholders until each founder confirms theirs from `larpo-x-engine` settings (knowledge/x/x-engine-audit.md section 5).
